module: Flowgraph node "Move Veh to Start Position" (category repeat_instant, tags scenario and race). Moves (and repairs by default) a vehicle to a start position of a pathData. Position choice: id pin if provided, otherwise according to reverse/rolling among defaultStartPosition, reverseStartPosition, rollingStartPosition, rollingReverseStartPosition; the name pin, if set, takes precedence (findStartPositionByName). Inputs: vehId, name, lowPrecision, pathData, id, reverse, rolling, repair. Outputs: pos (vec3), rot (quat), exists (bool).
notes: If the position cannot be found, a warning is logged (mgr:logEvent) and exists stays false.
In the code, the repair pin contains the typo "hidde = true": it is therefore not hidden.
The old pin vehID is redirected to vehId (legacyPins).

work.desc: Chooses the start position, calls sp:moveResetVehicleTo(vehId, lowPrecision, repair) and writes pos/rot to the output.
